reddit.title: Explore the New Conquest Mode in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest update on the conquest mode in Provincia! Dive into a fresh campaign with five unique territories to conquer, each offering different resources and challenges. Check out the details and join the discussion here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

steam.title: Conquer New Territories in Provincia!
